title: RNA Extraction and RT-qPCR
author: Haley Geertsma
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b5wmq7c6

steps.title: Homogenize Hemibrain
steps.instruction: Homogenize the hemibrain in 3mL of 1X PEPI buffer using a dounce homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1X PEPI Buffer consisting of 5mM EDTA + 1X protease inhibitor in 1X phosphate buffered saline (PBS)

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the homogenate using TRIzol Reagent.

substeps.instruction: Follow the TRIzol user guide for the remainder of the extraction

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA using the 5X All-In-One RT Master Mix Kit.

steps.title: Perform qPCR
steps.instruction: Perform qPCR using the following thermal cycling settings:

substeps.instruction: 40 cycles of: 95 °C for 15 seconds, then 60 °C for 60 seconds
